privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Muhandes HUB is owned and operated by Remal Al Mas International Company. At Muhandes HUB, we are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring the security of your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your data.

dataCollection.title: 1. Information We Collect
dataCollection.description: We collect the following types of information:

personal.title: Personal Information
personal.item1: Name, email address, and phone number
personal.item2: Company name and commercial registration details

usage.title: Usage Data
usage.item1: Log data (IP address, browser type, pages visited)

dataUsage.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
dataUsage.item2: Processing registrations and verifying business credentials
dataUsage.item3: Facilitating transactions and generating ZATCA-compliant invoices
dataUsage.item5: Improving platform functionality and user experience
dataUsage.item6: Preventing fraud and ensuring platform security
dataUsage.item7: Complying with legal obligations and tax regulations
dataUsage.item8: Responding to your inquiries and support requests

dataSharing.title: 3. Information Sharing and Disclosure
dataSharing.description: We may share your information with:

serviceProviders.title: Service Providers
serviceProviders.description: Third-party vendors who assist us in operating the platform (e.g., payment processors, hosting providers, email services). These providers are bound by confidentiality agreements.

otherUsers.title: Other Platform Users
otherUsers.description: Your business profile, including company name, services offered, and contact information, is visible to other verified users on the platform.

legal.title: Legal Requirements
legal.description: We may disclose information when required by law, court order, or government regulation, including compliance with ZATCA requirements.

businessTransfers.title: Business Transfers
businessTransfers.description: In the event of a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets, your information may be transferred to the acquiring entity.

security.title: 4. Data Security
security.description: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your information, including encryption, secure servers, and access controls. However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

retention.title: 5. Data Retention
retention.description: We retain your personal information for as long as necessary to provide our services, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our agreements. Business and transaction records are retained for at least 10 years in compliance with Saudi tax laws.

rights.title: 6. Your Rights
rights.item3: Request deletion of your data (subject to legal retention requirements)
rights.item4: Object to processing of your information
rights.item6: Request a copy of your data in a portable format
rights.contactNote: To exercise these rights, contact us at info@muhandeshub.com.

cookies.title: 7. Cookies and Tracking
cookies.description: We use cookies and similar technologies to enhance your experience, analyze usage patterns, and provide personalized content. You can control cookie preferences through your browser settings, though disabling cookies may affect platform functionality.

internationalTransfers.title: 8. International Data Transfers
internationalTransfers.description: Your information may be transferred to and processed in countries outside Saudi Arabia where our service providers operate. We ensure appropriate safeguards are in place to protect your data in accordance with this Privacy Policy.

children.title: 9. Children's Privacy
children.description: Muhandes HUB is intended for business use only and is not directed at individuals under 18 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal information from minors.

changes.title: 10. Changes to This Privacy Policy
changes.description: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. We will notify you of material changes via email or platform notifications. Your continued use after changes indicates acceptance of the updated policy.

contact.title: 11. Contact Us
contact.description: If you have questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us at:

privacy.consent: By using Muhandes HUB, you consent to the collection and use of your information as described in this Privacy Policy.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: Welcome to Muhandes HUB, a B2B electronic marketplace platform owned and operated by Remal Al Mas International Company under the laws of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. These Terms of Service constitute a legally binding agreement between you and Muhandes HUB. By accessing, registering, or using our platform, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by these terms in their entirety. If you do not agree, you must not access or use our services.

definitions.title: 1. Definitions and Interpretation
definitions.description: In these Terms: 'Platform' means the Muhandes HUB website and all related services; 'User' means any registered business entity using the Platform; 'Contractor' means a User who posts projects seeking bids; 'Supplier' means a User who offers products; 'Service Provider' means a User who offers services; 'Deal' means a completed transaction between Users; 'Commission' means the percentage fee payable to Muhandes HUB upon Deal completion; 'Subscription Fee' means the periodic fee for Platform access; 'SAR' means Saudi Arabian Riyals; 'VAT' means Value Added Tax as defined by ZATCA regulations.

acceptance.title: 2. Acceptance of Terms and Legal Capacity
acceptance.description: By registering for or using Muhandes HUB, you represent and warrant that: (a) you have the legal authority to bind your business entity to these Terms; (b) you have read and understood these Terms in full; (c) you accept these Terms on behalf of your business entity; (d) your use of the Platform will comply with all applicable laws of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, including but not limited to the E-Commerce Law (Royal Decree No. M/126), the Commercial Register Law, VAT regulations, and Anti-Money Laundering regulations. These Terms, together with our Privacy Policy, constitute the entire agreement between you and Muhandes HUB.

eligibility.title: 3. Eligibility Requirements
eligibility.description: To use Muhandes HUB, you must satisfy ALL of the following requirements: (a) be a legally registered business entity in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia with a valid Commercial Registration; (b) possess a valid VAT Registration Certificate issued by ZATCA; (c) have an authorized representative who is at least 18 years of age and legally competent to enter into contracts; (d) not be subject to any legal prohibition, bankruptcy proceedings, or sanctions that would prevent you from conducting business; (e) provide accurate, complete, and current information during registration and maintain its accuracy throughout your use of the Platform. Muhandes HUB reserves the right to verify your eligibility at any time and to suspend or terminate accounts that fail to meet these requirements.

accounts.title: 4. User Accounts and Security
accounts.item1: You are solely responsible for maintaining the confidentiality and security of your account credentials, including passwords and access tokens.
